newsitem.title: USA: Fire closes Crown Central Pasadena alkylation unit.
newsitem.headline: Fire closes Crown Central Pasadena alkylation unit.

text.p: Crown Central Petroleum closed the alkylation unit at its Pasadena, Texas refinery after a fire in the early hours of Thursday morning, local environment and company officials said.

The fire occurred in the depropanizer tower of alkylation unit number two, with a capacity of 4,500 barrels per day (bpd) at around 0240 CST/0740 GMT and the fire was extinguished about 0515 CST, according to the Community Awareness Emergency Response (CAER) hotline in Texas.
